title: Plaster finishes.
officialText:
Where plaster is applied to the wall, the total fire-resistance rating shall be determined by the formula: R=(R 0.59+pl)1.7 (Equation 7-9) n where:

R = The fire endurance of the assembly (hours).

Rn = The fire endurance of the individual wall (hours).

pl = Coefficient for thickness of plaster. Values for R 0.59 for use in Equation 7-9 are given in Table 721.4.1(3). Coefficients for thickness of plaster shall n be selected from Table 721.4.1(4) based on the actual thickness of plaster applied to the wall or partition and whether one or two sides of the wall are plastered.
